newsitem.title: USA: Apple co-founder Jobs rejects CEO post--report.
newsitem.headline: Apple co-founder Jobs rejects CEO post--report.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc co-founder Steve Jobs has rejected offers from the company to become chairman and chief executive, the Wall Street Journal reported Thursday.
The newspaper said that since Gilbert Amelio was ousted as Apple chief three weeks ago, Jobs has been running meetings at the company and otherwise acting as CEO.
But Jobs simply wants to oversee Apple's affairs long enough to point the company in the right direction and see a good CEO hired, the report said.
The newspaper cited an unnamed "close associate" of Jobs as the source of its information.
It said neither Jobs nor Apple would comment on the matter.
